name: Four Seasons Maldives at Kuda Huraa
insider_take: This isn't just a resort—it's your own private coral atoll where tropical sophistication meets pristine wilderness in the heart of North Malé Atoll.
whats_special: Kuda Huraa sits on a living coral reef that's been naturally forming for centuries, making it one of the few resorts where you can snorkel directly from your villa into untouched house reef. The resort's Marine Discovery Centre houses the Maldives' only turtle rehabilitation program, where rescued sea turtles recover before returning to the wild.
pro_tip: Book the Two-Bedroom Water Suite during turtle nesting season (May-October) for front-row seats to baby turtle releases, plus complimentary access to the marine biologist's guided reef walks.
dont_miss: The sunset dolphin cruise aboard the resort's traditional dhoni boat—pods of spinner dolphins frequent these waters at golden hour. Also experience the "Castaway Picnic" on a completely uninhabited sandbank that appears only at low tide, accessible exclusively to Kuda Huraa guests.
pros: Overwater and beachfront villa accommodations with direct ocean access
World-class spa with traditional Maldivian treatments
Exceptional marine life and snorkeling opportunities at house reef
Multiple dining venues featuring fresh seafood and international cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfer
